episodes.synopsis: Now that their adventure in Rakua is over, Liko and the others have just been sitting around absentmindedly without doing much of anything. However, one day Friede visits them and invites them along for some fieldwork to investigate an amazing Pokémon. That Pokémon turns out to be a Hinbass...
episodes.title: Reboot! Off to the World of Adventure!!

episodes.synopsis: News of the Rising Volt Tacklers helping people has become the talk of the town all over... however, Liko and the others have absolutely no idea what these stories are referring to. Could there be impostors around...? The group head off to investigate in order to find out what's going on... and believe it or not, while they're asking around for information, they discover a second Brave Asagi?! Just who are the Fake Rising Volt Tacklers...?
episodes.title: Enter the Fake Rising Volteccers!?

episodes.synopsis: Laudbon and the others are starving, but as they search for berries, a Metamon who's tried to Transform into Cap appears before them. The naive and childlike Metamon quickly befriends the Pokémon from the airship, however...
episodes.title: The Secret Metamon Rhapsody

episodes.synopsis: Metamon crashes one of Gurumin's livestreams after having tried to Transform into her. Dot gets upset about this and wants to pretend it never happened, but the "Mini-Gurumin" incident actually becomes quite the talk of of town in her fandom... so Dot decides to take Metamon along for the bread festival she's been invited to hold a show at...
episodes.title: Clap Clap Clap! Mini Gurumin!!

episodes.synopsis: Liko and the others land on Aeos Island! There, Liko, Roy, Dot, Uruto and Friede will try their hands at a Unite Battle!
episodes.title: READY GO! Unite Battle!!

episodes.synopsis: Liko and the others have arrived in Miare City,and go visit the Handsome House, where they meet Matiere and her assistant Navi. Navi really loves Pokémon,and takes a great interest in Liko and the others. Just then, Matiere receives a request to locate a Melecie. And when the group starts investigating, they learn that a large blonde man wearing a dougi was accompanying it.
episodes.title: Miare City! New Encounters

episodes.synopsis: Navi is really depressed due to losing the Dream Ball. It was really dear to her, as she had been given it by Matiere so that she'd one day use it to catch hold of her dream... Meanwhile, Metamon picks up the Dream Ball Navi dropped on the airship and decides to head off to Miare City all by itself in order to return it to her...! Will Metamon be able to find Navi and return the Dream Ball safe and sound?!
episodes.title: A Dream Ball for You!

episodes.synopsis: Navi has got Metamon and become a member of the Rising Volt Tacklers! The upfront and enthusiastic Navi immediately hits it off with the rest of the crew, but just doesn't seem to click with Uruto... Liko suggests the two of them run an errand in the nearby town, but as expected, they end up fighting again! But when Navi goes off on her own, she ends up getting lost?!
episodes.title: Navi's Little Big Adventure!

episodes.synopsis: The mystical land of Area Delta is said to have a terrifying Pokémon that abducts trespassers into another world... and it's a Mega Rayquaza?! Pokémon journalist Sohdayo invites Liko and the others along to ascertain the truth... however, they're faced with one mysterious, unnatural phenomenon after another...?!
episodes.title: Shocking! Mega Rayquaza and the Mysterious Land!?

episodes.synopsis: Just as Wanival and Dekanuchan are suffering from sleep deprivation, Liko and the others run into Professor Neroli, a researcher of Pokémon sleeping. They all travel together to Wakakusa Island to try using the power of the Kabigon there to put Wanival and Dekanuchan to sleep, but the hungry Kabigon ends up waking up... and the group starts working on trying to make Comatose Butter Curry in order to fill it up and make it go back to sleep!!
episodes.title: Wanival and Dekanuchan's Great Sleep Operation!

episodes.synopsis: Liko decides to enter a Pokémon Contest with Masquernya, Laudbon and Wanival! And after getting trained by the self-styled "coach" Navi, it's finally time for the real deal! The venue is filled with skilled performers, last but not least the Pikachu idol group "Cutie Pikapika", and Liko starts feeling quite uneasy as she watches them perform...
episodes.title: Crazy Feels! This Is a Pokémon Contest, Dearie!!

episodes.synopsis: One day Liko and the others go watch a Mototokage race, where Liko ends up encountering a Miraidon and Roy ends up encountering a Koraidon. The two mistake these Pokémon for Mototokage and befriend them by feeding them, but when Koraidon and Miraidon hear the sounds of the race, they break into a dash... and Liko and Roy somehow end up entering the race as a result.
episodes.title: Koraidon & Miraidon! The Great Paldea Race!!

episodes.synopsis: Liko and Navi visit a cafe to try a Metamon collab menu they're offering. There they encounter Yakata, an office worker with a Namakobushi and a Yukihami on his shoulders and a Bachinuni on his head. Yakata explains how he loves squishiness more than anything, and invites Liko and the others to to try "SquishyPoké Activities", or "SquiPoActs" for short; Activities all about loving and cherishing squishy Pokémon.
episodes.title: A Squishy Pokémon! If You Squish It and It Squishes, It's Squishy Time

episodes.synopsis: Liko and the others get invited to join Friede on some fieldwork of his, where they're also accompanied by Professor Willow, a professor traveling the world to research Pokémon! As they conduct their research, Liko and the others ask Friede how he and Lizardon first met. It turns out that this happened while Friede was still a kid and Lizardon was a Hitokage... and it's now time to reveal that story.
episodes.title: The Expanding World, GO with You!

episodes.synopsis: The Rising Volt Tacklers visit a festival in the Land of Kitakami, where Liko and the others meet Seille again. Meanwhile Navi, who's never been to a Kitakami festival before and is in really high spirits, meets a mysterious kid wearing a mask. They play together and become friends, but...
episodes.title: Navi and the Mysterious Masked Child

episodes.synopsis: As Liko and the others wonder what Pokémon it was that defiled the offerings, Diana and Momowarou arrive in the Land of Kitakami as well, and they all decide to walk around the festival together. There, Momowarou encounters Iineinu, Mashimashira and Kichikigisu, the Pokémon referred to as the Little Companions. And it seems they were actually Momowarou's former companions...?!
episodes.title: The Revered Companions Attack! Momowarou's Decision!!

episodes.synopsis: Navi meets the Star Gang, while Raifort asks Liko and the others to investigate the strange phenomena occurring in the Paldea region.
episodes.title: Paldea in Ruin: Resurrection (1)

episodes.synopsis: The Ruinous Pokémon were completely beyond Liko and the others' capabilities. Raifort tells them that according to legend, these four were apparently born from "curses placed upon treasures"... But why are the Ruinous Pokémon on a rampage? In addition, the group learns that the quartet is heading for Table City, the location of Orange Academy. Orange Academy and the campus festival are in danger!!
episodes.title: Paldea in Ruin: Charge (2)

episodes.synopsis: Protect Orange Academy and everyone's campus festival! The Ruinous Pokémon head towards Table City from the four corners of Paldea. If the four were to gather, a catastrophe would unavoidable... Liko and the other split into four groups and do their upmost to stop the Ruinous Pokémon, but find themselves getting more and more driven against the wall by their overwhelming power. And then, the four ultimately meet up...?!
episodes.title: Paldea in Ruin: Reunion (3)

episodes.synopsis: Liko and the others take the Syaritatsu with them to Lake Zugogo, where they meet a group of Heyrusher! The Syaritatsu are curious about the Heyrusher, however... it looks like the Heyrusher are scared of something? It turns out they're actually being bullied by cruel Migalusa that live in the lake... But when the Syaritatsu learn this, they suddenly jump into the Heyrusher's mouths...?!
episodes.title: Syaritatsu, Order Up!

episodes.synopsis: One night, a parent and child get surrounded by a group of Shizariger. But just as the Shizariger are about to attack, rescue arrives in the form of... the legendary hero Mighty G! ...or actually, in the form of the heroic gentleman Dandy H?! But who in the world is he?! Dandy H then challenges Mighty G to a duel in... believe it or not, curry cooking...?!
episodes.title: Making a Magnificent Entrance! Dandy H!!

episodes.synopsis: After learning there's been eyewitness accounts of weak and frail Pokémon nearby, Molly goes looking for them and discovers a group of Donmel that are cold and in poor shape. They need heat...! Just then, the Magmag and Toroggon that are normally always in the engine room approach her?! Orio joins them soon after, having been searching for the duo. Will this group be able to save the Donmel?!
episodes.title: A Heart Burning with Passion Spreads Like Wildfire

episodes.synopsis: The "Soleilstone" is a rock said to contain the power of eternal earth. Uruto really wants it for his rock collection, so he decides to go search for it alongside Dot, who's after a topic that can go viral online! Thanks to the stone searching expert Yamirami, the two are able to locate the cave where the stone can be found, but they're unable to find the actual stone there. Not only that, but a furious Crimgan shows up as well, forcing them to battle it! And then the Crimgan's fierce attacks end up causing a cave-in...?!
episodes.title: Uruto and Yamirami! A Bond More Solid Than Stone!!
